title: Fun with Shapes
subject: Maths
learning_objectives: Recognise a circle, a square, and a triangle
Count the sides of a shape

sections.title: Let's find shapes!
sections.content: Shapes are all around us. A ball is a circle. A window is a square. A slice of pizza is a triangle. Let's play with them!
sections.image_description: A friendly circle, square, and triangle with smiling faces.

sections.question: Which one is a circle?
sections.hint: A circle is round with no corners.
sections.correct_feedback: Yes! A circle is round all the way around.
sections.incorrect_feedback: That one has corners. A circle is round with no corners at all.

sections.hint: Count the straight edges of a triangle with your finger: 1, 2, 3.
sections.correct_feedback: Well done! A triangle always has three sides.
sections.incorrect_feedback: It is true! Count them: one, two, three. A triangle has three sides.

sections.instruction: Match each shape to something that looks like it.
sections.hint: Picture each thing in your head. What shape is it?
sections.incorrect_feedback: Almost! A ball is round like a circle, a window is a square, and pizza is a triangle.

completion_message: Yay! You found circles, squares, and triangles. You are a shape star!
